# Ls019 — Missing closing `)` of an aggregate (paren imbalance)

## Description

Truncated coordinate list `((1.,2.,3.),(4.,5.,6.)` (one `)` short) causes scanners to walk past the `;` of the next instance. Particularly common when nested aggregates contain empty inner lists (`(())` vs `()`).

## Reproducer recipe

`#1=IFCPOLYLINE((#2,#3,#4); #5=...`

## Expected kernel behavior

Track paren depth per instance; on `;` at depth>0, reject with "unbalanced parentheses" naming the unmatched open paren.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`
